entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE cycle CSV hydraulic-pressure channel HydPressure[IRT/Pascoe].
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named numeric channel; physical unit is not encoded in the public cycle header, so values remain source-scaled.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: The channel is clearly hydraulic pressure but its numerical values must not be converted or compared cross-machine until the source unit and signal definition are verified.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE cycle CSV screw-position channel ScrewPosition[IRT/Pascoe].
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named numeric channel; public header does not encode a physical unit, so source scale is preserved.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Screw-position trends can support within-source cycle analysis, but values cannot be translated into universal position/volume settings without source-unit and geometry verification.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE mould-temperature channel TempMold1[IRT/Pascoe] in each cycle CSV.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named numeric mould-temperature channel 1; the public cycle header does not encode a physical unit.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Channel 1 is a local mould-temperature signal; absolute values remain source-scaled and cannot be used as universal mould-temperature guidance.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE mould-temperature channel TempMold2[IRT/Pascoe] in each cycle CSV.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named numeric mould-temperature channel 2; the public cycle header does not encode a physical unit.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Channel 2 is a local mould-temperature signal; absolute values remain source-scaled and cannot be used as universal mould-temperature guidance.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE physical pressure channel Pressure1[IRT/Pascoe] in each cycle CSV.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named numeric pressure channel 1; exact physical location/unit is not explicit in the public header.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Pressure channel 1 is accepted as a named physical pressure signal, but location and units must be verified before cross-source interpretation.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE physical pressure channel Pressure2[IRT/Pascoe] in each cycle CSV.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named numeric pressure channel 2; exact physical location/unit is not explicit in the public header.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Pressure channel 2 is accepted as a named physical pressure signal, but location and units must be verified before cross-source interpretation.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Relative timing/shape/amplitude comparison between PASCOE Pressure1 and Pressure2 while retaining their unresolved physical locations.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source-scaled differential or relative feature; exact unit/location must remain unresolved until publisher metadata establishes them.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: The two-channel comparison can reveal repeatable within-source differences but cannot be labelled cavity imbalance or pressure loss without verified sensor locations.

evidence.role: two direct pressure channels enable bounded relative comparison

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE quality-label file links cycle identifiers to separate Cavity 1 and Cavity 2 labels.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Cycle/cavity label linkage; labels are categorical quality evidence rather than direct sensor measurements.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Cavity-resolved labels must stay attached to cavity identity and cannot be averaged into a single shot label when diagnosing local process behaviour.

evidence.role: source quality file with cycle and two cavity labels

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE post-moulding physical length measurement from the dimensional-quality CSV.

entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Measured part length is a physical quality outcome; it supports validation but does not identify one process root cause without controlled evidence.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE Analog Input[1] and Analog Input[2] channels whose physical meanings are not documented in the public benchmark profile.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Unknown numeric channels are preserved but excluded from accepted physical-sample interpretation until semantics are established.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: An undocumented numeric channel must not be renamed as temperature, pressure, force or another physical quantity based on shape alone.

evidence.role: two unknown analog inputs explicitly excluded from physical sample ledger

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: PASCOE Time field across 307 cycle CSV files where the published header does not establish a normalized physical time unit.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source time values are retained as published; no automatic seconds/milliseconds conversion is allowed.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Waveform derivatives, durations and frequency-domain features require verified time units; convenience assumptions about the Time column are not accepted evidence.
